39159.overview: A video arcade mahjongg game with a theme based on the Japanese manga series Salaryman Kintarō

39176.overview:
Samurai Spirits Tenkaichi Kenkakuden is a dream match game which features the entire cast from Samurai Shodown V Special, seven returning characters from Samurai Shodown and Samurai Shodown II, and several new characters added to the Playstation 2 port of the game.

The story is parallel to Samurai Shodown V; Yoshitora decides to find out who the strongest fighter in the world is, so a tournament is then organized with this purpose.

The game is similar to the Samurai Showdown V Special; however, the player is now capable of using one of six different fighting systems, all of which have their own advantages and disadvantages. Items like bombs and rocks can also be picked up and thrown at the enemy.

91842.overview: Sega Clay Challenge is a Atomiswave light gun game released by Sega in 2008. It was also sold as a conversion kit for Extreme Hunting, Extreme Hunting 2, Ranger Mission or Sports Shooting USA - any Atomiswave game which is compatible with the Sega NAOMI universal upright cabinet (with light guns).

91852.overview: Knights of Valour: The Seven Spirits (新·三国戦紀 七星転生) is a 2003 side-scrolling beat-'em-up by International Games System for the Atomiswave. The plot is loosely adapted from the Chinese historical novel Romance of the Three Kingdoms and features the Five Tiger Generals, Zhuge Liang, Diaochan and others as playable characters. The gameplay involves the use of magical powers that are not featured in other games also based on the novel.

91860.overview: Compete on the speed, accuracy, and technique in this faithful reproduction of the world of target shooting. Guns are the exclusive Sammy scope gun with laser sight. Single or twin player game, which allows you to play against the computer or a friend. The game is very addictive giving you the chance to improve your ability to score the highest points, qualifying you to the next level. After the end of the events you are then graded. There are four levels from Beginner to Master, and you can play up to a hundred different events. The targets vary between moving targets and still targets, so keep your eyes peeled!

92607.overview: Sega Bass Fishing Challenge (セガバスフィッシングチャレンジ) is the latest entry in the Sega Bass Fishing series. It was released for the Atomiswave arcade platform in 2009 and was released for iOS devices in autumn 2011.

155543.overview: Sushi Bar is a puzzle game for the Sammy Atomiswave arcade board. The gameplay is very similar with Puyo Puyo where the player must rearrange various foods of the traditional Japanese culinary to unlock the next level. The game was released only in Japan.
